typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{GRC-MEMBER-ID} as string,
		{GRC-MEMBER-FIRSTNAME} as string,
		{GRC-MEMBER-LASTNAME} as string,
		{GRC-MEMBER-DISCHARGE-DATE} as string,
		{GRC-MEMBER-DATE-OF-DEATH} as string,
		{GRC-MEMBER-MCO-PLAN-ID} as string,
		{GRC-MEMBER-MCO-ASSIGNMENT-START-DATE} as string,
		{GRC-MEMBER-MCO-ASSIGNMENT-END-DATE} as string,
		{GRC-HHS-TO-MCO-FILE-SENT-DATE} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FFSRCMemberData
FFSRCMemberData derive(GRC_MEMBER_ID = {GRC-MEMBER-ID},
		GRC_MEMBER_FIRSTNAME = {GRC-MEMBER-FIRSTNAME},
		GRC_MEMBER_DISCHARGE_DATE = {GRC-MEMBER-DISCHARGE-DATE},
		GRC_HHS_TO_MCO_FILE_SENT_DATE = {GRC-HHS-TO-MCO-FILE-SENT-DATE},
		GRC_MEMBER_MCO_PLAN_ID = {GRC-MEMBER-MCO-PLAN-ID},
		GRC_MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_START_DATE = {GRC-MEMBER-MCO-ASSIGNMENT-START-DATE},
		GRC_MEMBER_LASTNAME = {GRC-MEMBER-LASTNAME},
		GRC_MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_END_DATE = {GRC-MEMBER-MCO-ASSIGNMENT-END-DATE},
		GRC_MEMBER_DATE_OF_DEATH = {GRC-MEMBER-DATE-OF-DEATH}) ~> DERTrimSpaces
DERTrimSpaces split(GRC_MEMBER_MCO_PLAN_ID == 'A',GRC_MEMBER_MCO_PLAN_ID != 'A', disjoint: true) ~> CSPLMCOPlanID@(MCO,MCOERROR,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
CSPLMCOPlanID@MCO sink(input(
		MEMBER_DISCHARGE_DATE as string,
		MEMBER_FIRSTNAME as string,
		MEMBER_DATE_OF_DEATH as string,
		MEMBER_MCO_PLAN_ID as string,
		MEMBER_LASTNAME as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		HHS_TO_MCO_FILE_SENT_DATE as string,
		MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_END_DATE as string,
		MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_START_DATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		MEMBER_DISCHARGE_DATE = {GRC-MEMBER-DISCHARGE-DATE},
		MEMBER_FIRSTNAME = {GRC-MEMBER-FIRSTNAME},
		MEMBER_DATE_OF_DEATH = {GRC-MEMBER-DATE-OF-DEATH},
		MEMBER_MCO_PLAN_ID = {GRC-MEMBER-MCO-PLAN-ID},
		MEMBER_LASTNAME = {GRC-MEMBER-LASTNAME},
		MEMBER_ID = {GRC-MEMBER-ID},
		HHS_TO_MCO_FILE_SENT_DATE = {GRC-HHS-TO-MCO-FILE-SENT-DATE},
		MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_END_DATE = {GRC-MEMBER-MCO-ASSIGNMENT-END-DATE},
		MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_START_DATE = {GRC-MEMBER-MCO-ASSIGNMENT-START-DATE})) ~> OLEDSTDOJREPORTINGMEMBERDATA
